verdict.rationale: Statsig's own docs state a free allotment of feature flags plus 2 million metered events. That identifies metered events as a cost driver and shows a free tier exists. Nothing in the evidence shows a published price list, paid tiers, or how seats, MAUs or requests affect cost. missing for 10: published pricing page with paid-tier prices, explanation of whether seats/MAUs/requests drive cost, overage rates, independent corroboration of pricing clarity.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing

citations.quote: You get feature flags and 2 million metered events for free.
